name: Special Treatment
source:
Stacey works in a café and one day meets the beautiful Delilah. It's love at first sight. Soon, Delilah begins regularly offering Stacey food. Due to her lack of self-confidence, Stacey doubts the sincerity of Delilah's feelings – but the truth turns out to be quite surprising.

[From [url=https://water-horse-games.itch.io/special-treatment]Itch.io[/url]]
